title: Cost-tuner replay harness and staged rollback acceptance with prompt-anchored QA
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build a deterministic replay-and-eval harness that exercises proposed batching/caching configuration changes (autotune suggestions) against a stable corpus of production-like prompts, produce composite QA signals tied to quality regressions, and gate staged canary rollouts with automated rollback triggers.

Background: We routinely generate cost-saving recommendations (batch sizes, KV cache TTLs, prefix reuse groups, quantization profiles). Prior incidents show small downstream quality regressions can be missed until end users see them. This ticket creates an auditable accept/reject evaluation path that sits between the recommendation engine and a staged apply. The harness must be reproducible, fast enough to make decisions within the apply window, and conservative by default.

Non-goals: Model training changes, live A/B experiments with external cohorts, or replacement of the existing golden-prompt repository (we will reuse and extend it).
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic replay harness that can run 5k representative requests in under 90 minutes on CI infra
Composite quality score computed per-run (semantic-match + token-level fidelity + hallucination penalty) and stored to the audit log
Automated pass/fail decision produced using pre-defined thresholds and statistical checks (see test_plan)
Canary rollout policy integrated with Console: 1% shadow -> 5% traffic canary -> 25% -> 100% with auto-rollback hooks
Playbook and runbook links added to the cost-tuner docs with example rollbacks and Slack alert templates
test_plan: Datasets: golden_prompts_anchor_v3 (2k prompts), holdout_qa_set (1k prompts with human labels), and replay_trace_sample (2k production traces anonymized)
Primary threshold: composite_score_delta >= -0.005 (no more than 0.5% absolute drop) across holdout_qa_set
Stat test: two-sided bootstrap with 1000 resamples; fail if p-value < 0.01 that new config < baseline OR median effect size <= -0.01
Secondary checks: increase in hallucination_penalty > 15% or any drop in top-k exact-match > 1% triggers manual review
Latency/cost checks: per-token latency increase > 8ms or expected per-token cost improvement < 2% cancels the apply
Determinism: replay must reproduce the prior baseline composite within 0.2% when running baseline config twice (sanity check)
rollout_plan: Stage 0 (pre-apply): run replay harness in CI mode and publish the composite_score report to Console and the audit S3 bucket
Stage 1 (shadow): apply config in shadow on 1% of traffic for 6 hours while collecting golden-prompt evaluations; no user-facing routing changes
Stage 2 (canary): 5% traffic for 24 hours with continuous evaluation; require rolling pass (no failed 1-hour windows) to proceed
Stage 3 (ramped): 25% for 24 hours, then 100% if no regression alerts
Auto-rollback triggers: any stage with composite drop beyond primary threshold OR automated health alerts (e.g., 2x error rate) will trigger immediate rollback and incident creation
rollback_criteria: Automatic: sustained 2x error rate or 15% latency regression over a 15-minute window
Manual: any SEV-1 customer report linked to the change
Post-rollback: run forensic replay with extended trace to capture failing prompts and tag them for the autotune learning set
notes: Tradeoffs: tighter thresholds reduce cost-savings velocity but increase safety; current thresholds are intentionally conservative for initial rollout.
We will reuse existing golden prompt labeller (see links) and augment with a diversity-focused sample to avoid overfitting to known edge cases.
Consider adding a lightweight synthetic adversary generator in a follow-up to stress hallucination checks.
